item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Bombs Central Beirut in Expanding Attack
item.summary: Israeli airstrikes pounded the Lebanese capital, expanding attacks on Hezbollah and displacing more Lebanese. In Iran, the newly appointed leader vowed his country would avenge “the blood of the martyrs.”

item.title: Iran’s Frantic Attempt to Save Its Ships Before Torpedo Attack
item.summary: The Iranian Navy sought refuge in Sri Lanka and India. While India obliged, Sri Lanka stalled over fears it would threaten its neutrality.

item.title: Ground Down by War, Hezbollah’s Loyal Base Shows Cracks
item.summary: “We just want to be back in our homes,” said a Lebanese man who, like many others in the latest round of fighting, has to flee.

item.title: Trump’s Iran War Is Causing Problems For His Ally in Italy, Giorgia Meloni
item.summary: War in the Middle East has left Italy’s prime minister in a domestic bind, presenting her with one of the biggest challenges of a previously stable tenure.

item.title: 15 Are Sentenced to Life for Moscow Concert Hall Massacre
item.summary: At least 149 people died in the 2024 terror attack outside the Russian capital, for which the Islamic State claimed responsibility.

item.title: Iran’s Retaliatory Strikes Appear to Be Slowing
item.summary: U.S. officials say the country’s weapons have been diminished, slowing its attacks on Gulf nations and Israel. Iran may also be holding some weapons in reserve in case the conflict is prolonged.

item.title: Iraq vents anger at strikes on former militias now under government control.
Yanar Mohammed, 65, Iraqi Women’s Rights Advocate, Is Killed by Gunmen
item.summary: She established a network of safe houses for abused women and was an outspoken critic of her country’s repressive institutions, despite the constant threat of violence.

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran’s New Supreme Leader, Says Strait of Hormuz Must Remain Closed in Defiant Statement
item.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei struck a defiant tone and signaled that Iran would not back down in a war that has spread across the Middle East.

item.title: Displaced Lebanese Haunted by Strikes from the Sky
item.summary: With airstrikes expanding beyond the limits of Beirut’s southern suburbs, people in the city say that even the once-safest corners may no longer be off-limits.
